add.name: merger-model
add.purpose: Builds M&A accretion/dilution analysis: pro forma EPS impact, synergy sensitivities and purchase-price allocation in Excel.
add.how_to_use: Use when evaluating an acquisition or preparing merger consequences for a pitch; works with the xlsx tooling in the plugin.
add.notes: Fills the M&A gap next to dcf/lbo/comps already listed.

add.name: gmgn-market
add.purpose: Crypto and meme-token market data via GMGN: K-line/OHLCV charts, trending tokens by volume, new launchpad tokens (pump.fun, Raydium, etc.), hot-search rankings and token/wallet search.
add.how_to_use: Needs the GMGN CLI/API per the repo README; read-only market data (trading skills live in sibling gmgn-* skills).
add.evidence: skills.sh gmgn-* skills ~15k installs each; created Mar 2026
add.notes: Very large (77KB) skill; meme-coin focus; high-risk area.
